title: LLM Evaluation Systems
description: Developed a modular LLM evaluation framework to assess lecture summaries across multiple quality dimensions. Designed ensemble-based evaluation systems, iterative refinement pipelines, and adaptive stopping criteria to improve summary quality through systematic experimentation.

title: Professional Esports Playstyle Analysis
description: Analyzed over 55,000 professional League of Legends matches to identify regional gameplay patterns. Engineered domain-specific features and compared supervised classification models to distinguish Eastern and Western teams, achieving 77.48% accuracy with a Random Forest classifier.

title: Music Genre Classification
description: Built a machine learning pipeline to classify music genres using MIDI-derived features from the Lakh MIDI Dataset. Extracted musical characteristics and evaluated multiple classification algorithms, using cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning to improve predictive performance.

title: Parkinson's Disease Typing Data Visualization
description: Developed an interactive visualization exploring how Parkinson's medication influences typing behavior using keystroke dynamics. Created interactive keyboard animations and visual analytics to compare typing latency and accuracy between medicated and unmedicated states.
